title: `papyrus today` and `papyrus agents` are generated from the operation table
description:
Generate the `agents` and `today` command groups and the MCP tools from the same operation table the newsroom uses, so there is one definition per operation and the three surfaces cannot drift. `--help` on each is real help, and every write accepts `--dry-run`.

**Acceptance criteria**
- Adding an operation to the table adds it to the CLI, MCP and newsroom.
- Every write has a dry run.
- Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs (below).

**Gherkin features needed**
- agents-cli-parity.feature: each operation exists on all three surfaces; a dry run writes nothing; help text comes from the table.

**Infrastructure as code touched:** None.

**Part of:** Human surface: Today, poke-in operations and explanations. Slice code H5 in `docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md` (section 12).
**Standing rules:** no fallbacks, no workarounds, no interim systems, no arbitrary caps; no text in DynamoDB; indexes over scans; no AppSync subscriptions; nothing created by hand in AWS; no real email addresses in specs or fixtures; status shown as words and marks, never colour alone.
